sources.title: Planar heat pipes reduce peak temperatures by up to 32 C in PV cooling tests
sources.excerpt:
An international research team has tested five planar heat pipe designs for PV module cooling, achieving peak surface temperature reductions of 8 C to 32 C. The researchers estimated that active water cooling could increase annual electricity generation by 2.2% to 3.6% under conditions in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
